summary: You held a full catch-up call with Bà Ngoại and stayed in Vietnamese for most of it. Your kinship pronouns (con/Ngoại) and polite “Dạ” were consistent throughout. You reached for English mostly on school words and everyday nouns.

missingWords.example: Tuần này con có bài kiểm tra giữa kỳ.
Con thức khuya để học bài.
Con muốn phụ Ngoại làm vườn.
Con về dịp Lễ Tạ Ơn.
Con ăn cơm gà với bạn.
Con đi ăn với bạn bè.

wins: “Con nhớ Ngoại lắm”: natural and warm, with “lắm” placed exactly right.
“Con thích canh chua nhất”: correct superlative with “nhất”.
Opened every reply with “Dạ”, which is perfect politeness for talking to a grandparent.

corrections.said: Cái garden của Ngoại sao rồi?
corrections.why: “Cái” is fine but unnecessary here; dropping it sounds more natural.
With elders, “con chào …” is the respectful goodbye.

pronunciationTips: Practice the hỏi tone in “khỏe” (dip then rise). It's easy to flatten into a ngang tone.
“Thương” ends in “-ương”: round your lips at the end.
nextSteps: Review the 8 missing words with flashcards; try school vocab first.
Next call, try to describe your week without “study” or “midterm”.
